description:
Bumble Bear Land has fallen to invaders from beneath the soil, and what was once a vibrant, peaceful utopia has become a dry, wretched husk. The royal lineage that once led the area to peace is all but gone, but one Princess intends to put things right and take back her home from its vicious would-be rulers...
